measurement.rectMethod: Measured alpha > 10 subject bounds plus 2 px padding; not uniform grid cuts.
measurement.anchorMethod: y = bottom edge of alpha > 127 subject. x = average x of the top 5 rows of the body back ridge in a visually selected torso region, rounded. This projects a stable torso landmark to the ground rather than following a moving paw.

inspection.characterConsistency: Mostly pass: face, markings, colors, pixel scale stay coherent. Back-to-ground height differs by about 3%; frame 4 compresses hindquarter silhouette but a large whole-body scale jump is not the main failure.
inspection.gaitConsistency: Fail: the visible near foreleg remains planted in all four frames (straight in 1/2, back-angled in 3, straight in 4). The raised foreleg in frame 4 is the other foreleg. Frame 3 re-extends the far foreleg after frame 2 retracts it. Limb identity and contact/passing phases do not form a complete ordered walk.
inspection.loopDecision: Keep as rejected candidate. Four distinct leg drawings are present, but they do not demonstrate a coherent four-phase same-limb cycle. Do not advertise this as a passed real walk animation.
